falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug rises from 76% to at least 90% and the S&P 500 closes at least 4% above its close on the verdict date.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom analog confirmed into a tradable low. UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong because the tape resolved into a long, not an unresolved hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 5% below its close on the verdict date and pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls to 50% or below.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog failed and price resolved into a breakdown. UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong because the regime was a continuation lower, not an ambiguous base.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, blowoff score prints at or above 70, or the VIX closes above 28 for three consecutive sessions.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The moderate-blowoff (38) unknown regime was false. A stress or blowoff state arrived, so HOLD was the wrong call during a decisive volatility regime.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
